title: I Will Sing of My Redeemer
lyrics: [G]I will sing of my [D]Redeemer, And His [D7]wondrous love to [G]me;
[G]On the cruel cross He [D]suffered, From the [D7]curse to set me [G]free.
[G]Sing, oh [C]sing, of my [G]Redeemer, With His [D7]blood, He purchased [G]me.
[G]On the [C]cross, He sealed my [G]pardon, Paid the debt, and [D7]made me [G]free.
I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love and mercy,
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And His heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath brought me,
Son of God with Him to be.
